findings.issue: Adoption date is March 13; official resolution says March 12. Institution also conflates NPC approval with CPPCC consultation.
findings.correction: Use adopted March 12, 2026; separately date republication of outline. NPC approved the plan; CPPCC discussed the draft.

findings.issue: Record says only House bill includes §3 military-company determination; Senate saved text also includes it.
findings.correction: Remove claimed House-only distinction from summary, limitations, and discrepancy list. Both introduced texts include §3.

findings.issue: Official root bill/latestAction now checked for all eight standalone robotics bills plus H.R.8800.
findings.correction: H.R.9129 latest action September 1: forwarded by subcommittee to full committee by voice vote. Other seven standalone bills latest actions are original referrals. H.R.8800 latest action September 14: received in Senate. No reviewed bill is enacted.

findings.issue: Senate sponsor field omits original cosponsor Chuck Schumer although some other records include original cosponsors.
findings.correction: For consistent attribution use sponsor Tom Cotton; original cosponsor Chuck Schumer. Dates, sponsors and referrals otherwise agree with saved introduced texts.

findings.issue: Four hearings should not be described as four robotics-only sessions or unprecedented activity. March session also covered AI/autonomy; June and July covered multiple technology/communications bills.
findings.correction: Describe four hearings involving robotics: April dedicated to robotics/manufacturing, March expressly AI/robotics/autonomy, June and July broader legislative hearings. A historical series would be needed to claim unprecedented frequency.

findings.issue: An official ten-track industrial count is not established by the plan.
findings.correction: Relevant clauses enumerate eight emerging-industry groups and six future-industry groups, with open-ended language. Robotics and embodied intelligence are distinct placements. Do not convert these into a formal ten-track taxonomy.

findings.issue: FCC July action can be conflated with GUARD proposal or Commerce trade investigation.
findings.correction: July 28 FCC listing is an actual administrative action on foreign-produced advanced devices, with conditional approvals. September 2025 Section 232 notice initiated trade investigation; neither that notice nor GUARD introduced text establishes a tariff or blanket ownership ban.

findings.issue: Initial bundle lacked operative text; newly saved H.R.8800 reported and House-engrossed text both contain §163. Markup log ID 6312 alone still does not establish every version-identification step.
findings.correction: Use House-passed §163 to describe DoD procurement, lease or otherwise obtaining covered humanoid systems tied to foreign-adversary nations/entities, specified software/services or remote-control authority. Includes controlled-testing waiver and industrial, non-networked and regulated-medical exclusions. Applies to post-enactment contracts; bill received in Senate September 14 and is not enacted.

findings.issue: Existing policies.json claims covered-entity list maintained by Commerce and DoD; introduced text defines covered entity by domicile/control and DHS/DoD determination, without that list requirement.
findings.correction: Correct existing seed in a future authorized edit; do not repeat invented list mechanism.

findings.issue: Existing commission policy has estimated budget $50 million; saved House introduced text contains no such funding amount.
findings.correction: Mark budget unsupported by this bill text; remove or independently source estimate. Commerce establishment and 18 members are supported.

findings.issue: SCSP JSON dates Humanoid ROBOT Act to February 2026 secondary coverage and says American Security Robotics Act takes effect one year after enactment without separating procurement from operation.
findings.correction: Use S.3275 introduction November 20, 2025; H.R.8189/S.4235 procurement prohibition has no one-year delay, while operation and federal-funds prohibitions start after one year.

findings.issue: SCSP commission and proposed National Commission on Robotics share terminology but different authority and timetable.
findings.correction: Keep SCSP nongovernmental commission separate from proposed statutory 18-member commission, whose reports run from establishment after enactment.

findings.issue: 6 of 21 claimed exact quotes fail whitespace-normalized substring check.
findings.correction: Failures include ellipsis-stitched S.3275 passage, reformatted Gooden table row, March revised-notice quote without saved artifact, absent Doshi sentence, July comma spacing, and FCC capitalization. Replace or label unverified; retain verbatim punctuation/case.

findings.issue: Existing GUARD record describes House NDAA §163 as China-only and a general procurement/leasing/operation prohibition. Saved House-engrossed operative clause prohibits procurement, lease or otherwise obtaining and defines foreign adversaries through covered nations, not China alone.
findings.correction: Use exact operative scope and foreign-adversary definition; do not present a separate blanket operation prohibition or enacted NDAA restriction.
